fusions.name: Bitten, Then Followed
fusions.desc: A foul-mouthed bite that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed and Thrashing
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sheds the tip of your tail, which thrashes musk across a cone 3 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Noon Basking
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds, and you have 20% more poison resistance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Left the Tail Behind
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you regain 5 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
